preface.docTitle: An Act to accelerate cybersecurity standards implementation and strengthen critical infrastructure resilience.

section.heading: Short title
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Cybersecurity Standards Acceleration Act”.

section.heading: Further amendments to definitions
section.chapeau: Section 1201 of the Cybersecurity Resilience Act (6 U.S.C. 1201), as amended by the Cybersecurity Enhancement and Modernization Act, is further amended—

paragraph.content: in paragraph (5), by striking “a discrete set of information resources” and inserting “a discrete set of information resources, including cloud-based and hybrid infrastructure,”;

if paragraph (7) (relating to supply chain risk) has not been added by prior enactment, by adding at the end the following:“(7) The term “supply chain risk” means the risk that an adversary may sabotage, maliciously introduce unwanted function, or otherwise subvert the integrity of a covered information system.”; and

by adding at the end the following:“(8) The term “zero trust architecture” means a cybersecurity framework that requires continuous verification of every user, device, and network transaction regardless of whether the user, device, or transaction originates inside or outside the network perimeter.”.

section.heading: Enhanced critical infrastructure protection
section.chapeau: Section 1202 of the Cybersecurity Resilience Act (6 U.S.C. 1202), as amended by the Cybersecurity Enhancement and Modernization Act, is further amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (c), by adding at the end the following:“(4) deployment of artificial intelligence-based anomaly detection systems for automated threat identification and response.”; and
in subsection (d), by striking “2 years” and inserting “18 months”.

subsection.heading: Critical incident timeline.—
subsection.content: Section 1203(a)(1) of the Cybersecurity Resilience Act (6 U.S.C. 1203(a)(1)), as amended by the Cybersecurity Enhancement and Modernization Act, is amended by striking “24 hours” and inserting “12 hours”.

subsection.heading: Enhanced penalty.—
subsection.content: Section 1203(b)(2) of the Cybersecurity Resilience Act (6 U.S.C. 1203(b)(2)), as amended by the Cybersecurity Enhancement and Modernization Act, is amended by striking “$500,000” and inserting “$750,000”.

section.heading: Zero trust implementation requirements
section.content: Section 1205(d) of the Cybersecurity Resilience Act (6 U.S.C. 1205(d)), as amended by the Cybersecurity Enhancement and Modernization Act, is amended by adding at the end the following:“(4) integration of automated security orchestration and response capabilities to enable real-time enforcement of zero trust policies across all agency information systems.”.
